## About
Miller Auto Care and Stock Restorations & Restomods is a family-owned shop on N. Rangeline Road in Carmel, owned by Keith and Debbie Stockberger. We're a single point of contact for all your auto maintenance and repair needs, and we also sell and align all tire brands.
Our business philosophy is built on Christian principles and summed up by a verse from Colossians: "Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord." We do our best to serve you that way and look forward to earning your trust.
Alongside the daily repair work, we run a full frame-off concours restoration and restomod shop. One reviewer came to pick up his car and found classic cars everywhere he looked. We hold a 4.3 rating from 143 Google reviews.

## Services
- Towing: We're an AAA-approved repair shop that offers after-hours towing services. Call us for more information.
- Brakes: Brake inspection and repair. Tell us what you're hearing and we'll take a look and call you with what we find.
- Oil Change: Oil changes with multipoint inspections, which can be the key to vehicle longevity.
- Tire Service: We sell all tire brands, so you can pick what fits your car and your driving.
- Wheel Alignment: We align all tire brands to keep your car tracking straight.
- Engine or transmission overhauls: The bigger jobs, handled in the same shop that does your oil changes.
- Restorations & Restomods: Full frame-off concours restorations and restomod work for classic cars.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday - Friday: 7:45 AM - 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. Feel free to use our after-hours drop box.

Q: How do I schedule service?
A: Send a service request through our appointment form, and we will be in touch with you within 24 hours to schedule a time that works well for you.

Q: Can I wait while you work on my car?
A: The appointment form lets you tell us whether you'll wait for your vehicle or leave it with us.

Q: Do you run promotions?
A: Yes. As a NAPA partner, we offer monthly promotions, so check back each month to see what's running.
